subject: GCP co-sell listing: support hours & trademark footnote?
messages:
From: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@protocolcloud.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GCP co-sell listing: support hours & trademark footnote?

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for walking us through the co-sell intake last week. We're preparing the GCP listing packet and hit a couple of quick compliance questions that will affect the timeline for the marketplace team:

1) Support hours: GCP's partner program notes that certain customers (especially regulated healthcare customers) require a published support window on the listing — some marketplace listings are limited to business-hours only while co-sell requires clear escalation coverage. Does Redwood publish a 24x7 support commitment for Hosted/Dedicated listings, or do you list business-hours-only by default? If 24x7 is available, could you point to the evidence (on-call rota or support matrix) we can include?

2) Trademark/brand footnote: GCP's policy review flagged our listing copy because it mentions ProtocolCloud is a "preferred provider" for two GCP solutions and uses a trademarked GCP badge in the asset. They asked for the precise licensing language we plan to use and confirmation we have rights to display the badge. Are there standard footnote templates Redwood uses that avoid endorsement implications?

Attached is our internal checklist (protocol_gcp_requirements.pdf) showing the items the marketplace QA team will ask for. Can you and your team confirm what we should submit so we don't get bounced during review?

Target timeline: we'd like to submit to GCP by 11/10. If we need additional legal signoff or an updated support SLA, please let us know what internal steps add time.

Appreciate the help—looping in Marissa and Laura from Redwood per your intake guide.

Best,
John Sullivan
Partnerships Manager | ProtocolCloud
john.sullivan@protocolcloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: protocol_gcp_requirements.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: John Sullivan <john.sullivan@protocolcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell listing: support hours & trademark footnote?

John —

Thanks for the clear list and the attached checklist. Short answers up front: we can support 24x7 for Dedicated customers (and can surface 24x7 as a marketplace attribute for the listing if you request it), but there are a couple of constraints to be aware of.

- Evidence for support hours: we typically provide a support matrix + escalation path + sample on-call rota and a runbook excerpt. I've attached the current support matrix (redwood_support_matrix_v2.xlsx) for your review. For Hosted listings we default to business-hours support with documented SLA windows unless the customer contracts a premium SLA.

- Trademark/badge language: Marissa (legal/gtm) and Laura (listing ops) are better placed to confirm the exact footnote phrasing; tagging them to propose the standard safe language that GCP wants.

Action items:
- Marissa: can you confirm the trademark footnote and any required brand asset license wording? Also flag any approval lead times (legal or brand).
- Laura: can you confirm the marketplace intake doc link we should point ProtocolCloud to and whether we need a DocuSign addendum for 24x7 SLA?

John — if 24x7 is required for the co-sell, our recommendation is to submit with the Dedicated listing attribute + the runbook/rota evidence and a 90-day trial of 24x7 covered by Redwood (we can evaluate long-term after co-sell onboarding). That usually keeps GCP happy while giving us time to finalize contract language.

I'll wait for Marissa/Laura to respond and will then send a single package back to you with the suggested copy and attachments.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_support_matrix_v2.xlsx (XLSX, stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-03T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell listing: support hours & trademark footnote?

Thanks for looping me in — quick guidance from the marketplace/brand side:

1) Trademark/badge copy: GCP wants a non-endorsement statement and a short rights statement for the badge. Recommended footnote (safe):
"ProtocolCloud and its trademarks are used with permission. References to GCP are for informational purposes only and do not imply endorsement by Google Cloud."

Do not use language like "preferred" or "certified by GCP" unless ProtocolCloud has explicit certification and a signed badge license. If you need, I can run a one-line approval request to our legal ops to confirm the exact badge file and metadata we are permitted to include. Legal turnaround historically: 2–3 business days if we include the draft copy.

2) Support evidence: For marketplace submission please include:
- Support matrix showing response/resolve times by severity (redwood_support_matrix_v2.xlsx)
- A short on-call schedule snapshot (1–2 weeks) showing nights/weekends coverage
- Escalation path document + email addresses/roles (oncall@redwood.com and escalation lead)
- A short excerpt of an SRE runbook showing how we handle infra incidents (we can redact internal-only ops creds)

I attached a copy of the marketplace copy draft (marketplace_listing_copy_draft.docx) with suggested language that avoids brand claims and includes the recommended footnote.

3) DocuSign/contract ask: if ProtocolCloud needs Redwood to commit to 24x7 in the contract, we'll need a DocuSign addendum signed by both sides. If ProtocolCloud is fine with a time-limited trial for co-sell (Hannah's suggestion), that avoids immediate legal work and speeds submission.

Proposed next step: Hannah, if you confirm you want me to trigger legal with the proposed footnote and the draft copy, I'll do that now and loop in legal ops with an ask for a 2–3 business day review. John, let us know if you'd prefer the addendum route.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: marketplace_listing_copy_draft.docx (DOCX, stub)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Date: 2028-11-03T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell listing: support hours & trademark footnote?

John — quick summary and proposed package to submit tomorrow: 

1) Marketplace copy: we'll use Marissa's safe footnote and the edited listing copy (attached). Sample footnote: "References to Google Cloud and related trademarks are used with permission and do not imply endorsement by Google Cloud."

2) Support evidence: attached are the support matrix (redwood_support_matrix_v2.xlsx), sample on-call snapshot, and a redacted SRE runbook excerpt. We will mark the listing attribute as "24x7" under Dedicated for the initial co-sell submission.

3) Legal/contract: we propose a 90-day complimentary 24x7 coverage for co-sell onboarding to avoid DocuSign delays. If ProtocolCloud prefers a binding SLA now, we can route the DocuSign addendum (link: https://app.docusign.com/MCP-2345) but that will add 3–5 business days.

Please reply with either: (A) "Proceed with 90-day trial" or (B) "Require addendum now" and we'll act accordingly. If we hear A, we'll bundle everything and submit to GCP by EOD 11/04 to meet your 11/10 target.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
